skill.name: algolia-search
skill.description: Guidance for implementing Algolia search with React InstantSearch, Next.js server rendering, indexing strategies, and relevance tuning.
skill.summary: Implement Algolia search patterns for React, Next.js, indexing, and relevance tuning.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The single static finding is a false positive. The flagged line is Algolia performance guidance about avoiding deleteBy, not system reconnaissance or host discovery.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 52 advises avoiding Algolia deleteBy because it is computationally expensive. This is performance guidance for an Algolia operation, not system reconnaissance or host discovery.

content.value_statement: Teams often need Algolia search patterns without sorting through scattered docs. This skill gives concise guidance for React InstantSearch, Next.js SSR, indexing, and relevance tuning.
actual_capabilities: Explains core React InstantSearch hooks for search boxes, hits, facets, pagination, and search state.
Describes Next.js server-side rendering with InstantSearchNext and initial search state.
Compares full reindexing, full record updates, and partial updates for Algolia data sync.
Recommends batching and incremental updates for large index changes.
Highlights performance concerns such as expensive deleteBy operations.
limitations: Provides guidance only, not runnable project code or automated setup scripts.
Does not cover every Algolia product feature or dashboard setting.
Does not include detailed security guidance for API keys and access controls.
Requires the user to verify current package names and framework support.

use_cases.title: Plan a React Search UI
use_cases.description: Map search input, result display, filters, pagination, and state handling before implementation.

use_cases.title: Add Search to Next.js
use_cases.description: Identify SSR setup steps, routing concerns, and initial state handling for an Algolia search page.

use_cases.title: Improve Index Updates
use_cases.description: Choose between full reindexing, full record updates, and partial updates for a data sync workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Search Components
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a basic Algolia search page with a search box, result list, filters, and pagination.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning a React search interface

prompt_templates.title: Plan Next.js SSR
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Next.js search page plan and explain how to use InstantSearchNext with initial search state.

prompt_templates.title: Select an Indexing Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare full reindexing, full record updates, and partial updates for my product catalog sync process.

prompt_templates.title: Tune Search Relevance
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my Algolia search requirements and suggest a relevance, faceting, and update strategy for scale.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced user improving production search quality

output_examples.input: I need a React search page with text search, brand filters, and pagination.
output_examples.output: Use a search box for query input, hits for result cards, a refinement list for brands, and pagination controls for result pages.

output_examples.input: My catalog changes many times per hour. Should I reindex everything?
output_examples.output: Use partial updates when only selected attributes change. Reserve full reindexing for schema changes or large data corrections.

output_examples.input: I want Algolia search in a Next.js page with server rendering.
output_examples.output: Use the Next.js InstantSearch integration, preserve routing state, and fetch initial search state before the page is rendered.

best_practices: Batch indexing work and keep batch sizes within Algolia guidance.
Use incremental or partial updates when only small record changes are needed.
Plan URL routing and search state before building a server-rendered search page.
anti_patterns: Using full reindexing for every small product or content update.
Relying on deleteBy for frequent cleanup jobs without considering cost.
Adding search widgets before defining index fields, facets, and ranking needs.

faq.question: Does this skill install Algolia packages?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation guidance, not package installation or project scaffolding.

faq.question: Can it help with React InstantSearch?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains common hooks for search input, results, filters, pagination, and search state.

faq.question: Does it cover Next.js server rendering?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes using the Next.js InstantSearch integration and initial search state.

faq.question: Can it choose an indexing strategy?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares full reindexing, full record updates, and partial updates.

faq.question: Does it manage Algolia API keys?
faq.answer: No. Users must design and review API key storage, permissions, and exposure separately.

faq.question: Is this skill tied to one framework?
faq.answer: It focuses on React and Next.js patterns, with general indexing advice for other stacks.
